It features rolled armrests and wooden legs, giving it a classic and comfortable appearance. The chaise lounge is positioned on a patterned rug that adds a touch of texture to the floor. In the background, there is a white wall with a simple, clean design. On the left side, there is a window allowing natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.
